sites.name: Hoi An Ancient Town
sites.event: UNESCO World Cultural Heritage, the busiest international trading port in Southeast Asia in the 16th-17th centuries.

sites.name: My Son Sanctuary
sites.event: UNESCO World Cultural Heritage, an ancient complex of Champa temples and towers, once the religious center of the Champa Kingdom.

sites.name: Cu Lao Cham
sites.event: World Biosphere Reserve, famous for its diverse coral reef system and Sa Huynh and Champa cultural relics.

sites.name: Monument of Mother Thu (Monument of Heroic Vietnamese Mother)
sites.event: The country's largest Heroic Vietnamese Mother Monument, modeled after Mother Nguyen Thi Thu (who had 9 sons, 1 son-in-law, and 1 grandson sacrifice their lives).

sites.name: Tra Que Vegetable Village
sites.event: A traditional vegetable-growing village over 300 years old, famous for its unique aromatic herbs.

sites.name: Phu Ninh Lake
sites.event: A major irrigation project, likened to the 'Green Pearl' of the Central region with a rich ecosystem and hot mineral water.

place.commune: Tam Dai Commune, Tam Lanh Commune...

sites.name: Thanh Ha Pottery Village
sites.event: A pottery village established in the 16th century, which once supplied bricks and tiles for the construction of the Hue Imperial Citadel.

sites.name: Ky Anh Tunnels
sites.event: One of the three largest tunnels in the South, a legend in the underground of Quang Nam during the anti-American resistance war.

sites.name: Bang Than Reef
sites.event: A masterpiece of stacked black slate created by nature, likened to the 'Ganh Da Dia' of Quang Nam.

sites.name: Dong Duong Buddhist Monastery
sites.event: An important archaeological site, once the capital Indrapura and the largest Buddhist center of the Champa Kingdom (9th century).

sites.name: Grang Waterfall
sites.event: A pristine 3-tier waterfall cluster located in the middle of the Truong Son forest, also known as 'Grang Triple Waterfall'.

sites.name: Tam Thanh Mural Village
sites.event: The first mural village in Vietnam, a Korea-Vietnam community art exchange project.
